# Brainstorming — Growth Planning

> Growth Planning is an agile strategic diagnostic by Brainstorming: three weeks working alongside the executive team to understand what's holding the business back and decide what to do first, with evidence, clear owners, and a roadmap for the next six months.

- English: https://us.brainstorming.la/
- Español: https://us.brainstorming.la/es
- Contact: conversemos@brainstorming.la · Book a free strategy call: https://us.brainstorming.la/#contact

## The method: 7 stages

- 00 Pre-Work: objective questionnaire and access to key platforms, commercial material, and organizational structure.
- 01 Business Self-Discovery: collaborative sessions with the executive team on value proposition, revenue model, channels, bottlenecks, and assumptions.
- 02 Stakeholder Research: in-depth interviews with current clients, ex-clients, prospects who didn't buy, and key team members.
- 03 Market Benchmark: direct and indirect competitors, market trends, and untapped opportunities.
- 04 Value Proposition & Positioning: positioning statement, Golden Circle, and unique value proposition.
- 05 Strategic Prioritization: exhaustive list of initiatives prioritized with the Impact-Effort Matrix.
- 06 Project Plan & Next Steps: 90–180 day roadmap with prioritized actions, owners, milestones, quick wins for the first 30 days, and an executive presentation.

## The deliverable

A decision system for the next 6 months: quick wins at 30 days, critical milestones at 90 days, and a complete roadmap at 180 days.

## Results from execution

- 4 out of 5 Growth Planning clients retained Brainstorming for the execution phase.
- AlumSpazio: 161 ROAS. Grin: 76 ROAS. Vive Paracas: 41 ROAS.
- SENATI: +14% gross revenue.
- Stanley Black & Decker: 100% of the annual leads goal in 9 months.
